components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Optional on create; defaults to the server's current date when omitted. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: Request-only flag. When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner has the same lastName and address (i.e. they share a household), and assigns both owners the same householdId. Not stored or returned (see the read-only householdId for the resulting shared identifier).
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:

              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true

              title: Display name

              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Franklin, George'

## Change: `namesakeCount` on owner create

`POST /api/owners` now records, at create time, how many existing owners share the new owner's `firstName` + `lastName` (compared case-insensitively, excluding the owner being created), and `GET /api/owners/{id}` returns it as a read-only `namesakeCount`.

**Files changed:**

1. **`openapi.yml`** — added a read-only `namesakeCount` (integer, min 0) to the `Owner` schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` gets a `namesakeCount` property that MapStruct maps automatically from the entity.

2. **`model/Owner.java`** — added an `Integer namesakeCount` field mapped to column `namesake_count`, with getter/setter. Used `Integer` (not `int`) so pre-existing seed rows with a `NULL` column don't blow up on load.

3. **DB schemas** (`hsqldb`, `h2`, `mysql`, `postgres`) — added the `namesake_count` column. Tests run on `hsqldb`; the schema files are the source of truth (no Hibernate DDL generation), so the column had to be declared there.

4. **`function/owner/CountNamesakes.java`** (new) — an OfficeFloor step following the existing `Verb+entity` convention: reads the still-unsaved `Owner` via `@Val`, iterates `ownerRepository.findAll()`, counts case-insensitive first+last name matches, and stores the result. Since the owner isn't saved yet, it isn't counted against itself — matching the "before this create" semantics already used by `AssignCustomerCode`.

5. **`officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml`** — wired `countNamesakes` into the pipeline (after `assignHousehold`, before `save`) under the existing `transaction` governance.

**Verification:** `AcceptanceTest.coreCountsNamesakes` passes (two "Ann Sur…" owners in different households → second owner reports `namesakeCount` = 1), and the full `mvn test` is `BUILD SUCCESS`.
